title: Clear the clippy error on main in the 014 mastery test and re-record the VC-203 evidence
goal: tests/gmcp_requirements/vc_203_014_part4.rs (rewritten by T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-110) annotates an array as [Box<dyn Fn(&mut Value)>; 9], which clippy -D warnings refuses as type_complexity, so cargo clippy -p susi --all-targets fails on main and every harness candidate is rejected at its lint gate. A local type alias with the borrow's lifetime clears it. The file is in every vector's evidence artifact set, so both phases of scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh are re-run.

results.change: A local alias `type Mutate<'a> = Box<dyn Fn(&mut Value) + 'a>` names the array's element type.
results.checks: cargo clippy --offline --locked --workspace --all-targets --features xtask/release-tooling -- -D warnings is clean; both phases of scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh passed (90 requirement checks, 15 mastery tests) and are recorded.
